brogath.//: Story Phase 14: Brogath the Bashful, an Ancient Grand Stenchmaster inside a cardboard cut-out. He becomes dangerous by being EMBARRASSED (flutter, being reminded he's cardboard or dead, apologising, failing at machinery, being laughed at, smelling); confidence calms him (praise, reframing an accident as intentional, 'distinguished', agreeing it was a toot, 'ceremonial', a harmless important job, safe television). ANGRY is a separate, scripted state (the Anger Waft). The meter is BASHFULNESS (WRATH when angry). Story Phase 15: MELLOW is a third kind of state, read from the ship's atmosphere (the Great Mellowing): while the air is MELLOW_HAZE every rise in pressure counts for an eighth, so a sash can flutter in front of him and he only finds it interesting. Wrath (ANGRY) still wins over it. Story Phase 16: RECOVERING (recoverFlag brogath_recovering, set by scripts after a big release): his rises count half as much until a script lets him out of it; triggers for Agnes the Second (clucking, frantic flapping), for being blamed, and for 'Is that all?'; calms for the chicken just chickening, the Fart Zone procedure and a good swarm; prompt sets for the near-miss and the Hornet Fart. Story Phase 17: a release can be PENDING (pendingValue brogath_pending, countdownVar coffin_sock_countdown): the meter shows COFFIN SOCK EVENT, PENDING, and the countdown (chapters 220-222). Triggers for the old crew's memories, accusations, the Princess Stenchalina rant, the beard's Coffin Sock notes, the Grand Restraint and a cigarette nearby; calms for his old friends, being listened to, the crew calming him, and holding his sash; prompt sets for the old crew and the Grand Restraint.
brogath.name: BROGATH
brogath.label: BASHFULNESS

flutter.line: brogath[bashful]: Oh. It... moved. Did anyone else see it move? Don't look. Nobody look.

flutter_big.line: brogath[embarrassed]: It's FLUTTERING. In front of EVERYONE.

squawks_flap.line: brogath[embarrassed]: The bird is... flapping. At me. Is he flapping AT me?

tripped.line: brogath[embarrassed]: I tripped. I have no knees and I TRIPPED.

fell_over.line: brogath[mortified]: I am on the floor. Face down. A Grand Stenchmaster. On the FLOOR.

sideways.line: brogath[embarrassed]: Can you... see me? I've gone sideways. People say I vanish when I go sideways.

reminded_cardboard.line: brogath[mortified]: ...Cardboard. Yes. Thank you. I had nearly forgotten.

reminded_dead.line: brogath[mortified]: Dead. I was dead. For CENTURIES. And then I came back as THIS.

apologized.line: brogath[sorry]: Sorry. Sorry! Now I'm apologising for apologising. Sorry.

misunderstood.line: brogath[confused]: Oh. That's not what that meant, was it. Oh, dear.

machinery.line: brogath[mortified]: It came off in my hand. The little wheel. It just came OFF.

criticized.line: brogath[sorry]: You're right. You're quite right. I'm terribly sorry.

smells.line: brogath[mortified]: I SMELL? I can't smell myself. I have no NOSE. It's PRINTED.

stupid_idea.line: brogath[embarrassed]: That was a stupid idea. Wasn't it. I can hear that it was.

embarrassed_again.line: brogath[mortified]: And now I'm embarrassed about BEING embarrassed.

tv_humiliation.line: brogath[mortified]: That's ME. On the television. Being POOR.

honesty.line: brogath[embarrassed]: Oh. Oh, I see. Just a... yes. Of course.

sighing.line: brogath[embarrassed]: Was that a sigh? At me?

treasure.line: brogath[mortified]: Treasure. Don't. Please. We don't talk about my treasure.

sad_memory.line: brogath[devastated]: I remember my funeral. Nobody stayed for the end. Well. Nobody COULD stay.

print_quality.line: brogath[mortified]: My face is SMUDGED? Where? WHERE?

jealous_garrick.line: brogath[bashful]: Is he cross with me? He looks cross with me.

goat.line: brogath[mortified]: The GOAT. They've shown the GOAT.

slow_motion.line: brogath[embarrassed]: Slowly. They're doing it SLOWLY. So you can see every bit of it.

unsupported.line: brogath[mortified]: There's nobody IN it. It's fluttering on its OWN.

mass_flutter.line: brogath[mortified]: All of them. TOGETHER. In TIME.

useless.line: brogath: Another thing I've broken. I do seem to break things.

flapworthy.line: brogath[embarrassed]: That sash is three yards long and it's FREE.

ad_mellow.line: brogath[embarrassed]: (slowly) Oh. A sash. That's... fluttering.

ordinary_stink.line: brogath[sorry]: That's... not the green one, is it. That's the ordinary one.

chicken_cluck.line: brogath[bashful]: (very quietly) She's... she's looking at me. Is she looking at me?

chicken_frantic.line: brogath[mortified]: She's running about! Because of ME! Everyone can SEE her running about!

blamed.line: brogath[sorry]: It was me. I know it was me. It's always me.

is_that_all.line: brogath[mortified]: (very small) ...Is that ALL? Did someone say is that ALL?

hornet_praise_none.line: brogath[confused]: Nobody's saying anything. Is the swarm not good? I thought it was a good swarm.

old_crew_memory.line: brogath: (very quietly) They'd have liked you, Captain. Tilda would have shouted at you. That's how you knew.

accused.line: brogath[mortified]: (shrinking) Everyone's SHOUTING. Is it me? Is it about me?

stenchalina_rant.line: brogath[mortified]: (bowing out at the middle) Captain, please, the Princess is a very sad story and you're doing it LOUDLY.

beard_notes.line: brogath[thoughtful]: (sniffing the air near your beard) ...Coffin Sock. With notes. Oh. Oh, that's stirring something.

restraint.line: brogath[loaded]: (bowing out, his seams puffing brown) Restraining. Grandly. It's all going very well.

fire_risk.line: brogath[alarmed]: Is that a CIGARETTE? Near me? While I'm RESTRAINING?

praise.line: brogath[pleased]: Oh! Well. Thank you. Thank you very much.

reframe.line: brogath[pleased]: Intentional. Yes. It WAS rather intentional, wasn't it.

confidence.line: brogath[thoughtful]: Confidently. Grand thoughts. Grand... yes. I'm having one.

dignified.line: brogath[proud]: Dignified. I have always tried to be dignified.

distinguished.line: brogath[proud]: Distinguished. Do you know, I think I am.

agree_toot.line: brogath[pleased]: A toot. Just a little one. Exactly.

impressive.line: brogath[delighted]: Impressive? Was it? Oh, it was, wasn't it.

ceremonial.line: brogath[proud]: A ceremonial flutter. Of course. It's a ceremony. They're SUPPOSED to flutter.

print_compliment.line: brogath[bashful]: Crisp? Do you think so? It is good card. Heavy-duty.

distraction.line: brogath[confused]: Oh, look at that. I've forgotten what I was worried about.

important_job.line: brogath[proud]: A JOB. An important one. I won't let you down.

covered_eyes.line: brogath[confused]: It's gone dark. Has the flutter stopped? Has it STOPPED?

consensual.line: brogath[thoughtful]: Consensual. Controlled. Commercial. Well. If they AGREED to it...

professional_sashes.line: brogath[proud]: Trained. And LICENSED. Then it's their JOB to flutter. Good for them.

ancient.line: brogath[thoughtful]: Ancient. Yes. I am, rather.

authentic.line: brogath[proud]: Authentic. An authentic Grand Stenchmaster event.

magnificent.line: brogath[proud]: A rather magnificent Stenchmaster fart. Yes. Yes, it WAS.

licensed_reenactment.line: brogath[thoughtful]: A licensed reenactment. With permission. Well, that's ALLOWED, then.

trained_sash.line: brogath[proud]: Trained. Of course. Years of training, that. You can tell.

controlled_flutter.line: brogath[thoughtful]: Controlled commercial flutter. Controlled. Yes. It is very controlled.

sash_performers.line: brogath[proud]: Professional sash performers. Doing their JOB. And doing it well.

ceremonial_movement.line: brogath[proud]: Ceremonial movement. Every ceremony has some. I've always said so.

historically_authorized.line: brogath[proud]: Historically authorised motion! Then there's PRECEDENT. Oh, I feel much better.

family.line: brogath[thoughtful]: Family. Yes. That's what they were. Idiots. MY idiots.

part_of_crew.line: brogath[pleased]: Part of the crew. You did say that. You did say that, didn't you.

creative_conversion.line: brogath[proud]: A creative conversion! An ECONOMIC one! I knew it would work.

distinguished_idiot.line: brogath[pleased]: A distinguished... yes. I'll take the first part.

agnes.line: brogath[thoughtful]: Agnes was a very good chicken.

chicken_just_chicken.line: brogath[pleased]: (watching her peck) She's just being a chicken, isn't she. Look at her. Just... chickening.

zone_procedure.line: brogath[pleased]: Door. Portholes. Sash. Procedure. I like a procedure.

good_swarm.line: brogath[proud]: It IS a good swarm. Thank you. I made it myself.

old_friends.line: brogath[delighted]: (between Ledger and Tilda, both arms round them, all three creaking) My crew. My actual crew.

listened.line: brogath[pleased]: (a long breath) Thank you for listening, Captain. Nobody's asked about them in four hundred years.

crew_calming.line: brogath[bashful]: (Tilda's hand on one shoulder, Ledger's on the other) In for four. Out for four. I'm doing it, Tilda.

restraint_hold.line: brogath[proud]: (holding his sash) Restraint. GRAND restraint. Look at me restraining.

options.text: That was entirely intentional. Very dignified.
You look extremely distinguished today.
Think confidently. Grand thoughts.
Excellent print quality. Very crisp.
It's fine. You're only cardboard.
Everybody saw. Don't worry about it.
Please stop apologising.
(sigh)
That was a ceremonial flutter. Very traditional.
Nobody saw a thing. You were magnificent.
Look over there! A... a beam!
It's just a bit of cloth, Brogath.
Everybody saw it move.
Don't be embarrassed. It's embarrassing.
That was a rather magnificent Stenchmaster fart.
A toot. Yes. A little toot. Agreed.
It was HISTORIC.
Stop apologising!
It was not a toot. It moved the TABLE.
options.reply: brogath[mortified]: The TABLE? I'm so sorry. I'm SO...

options.text: Nobody's hurt. Much.
Those are... consenting sashes. Consensual, controlled, commercial flutter.
Look at me, not the set. Distinguished face. Yours.
It's only an advert.
They're fluttering for YOU, Brogath.
They're PROFESSIONAL advertising sashes. Trained. And LICENSED for controlled commercial flutter.
It's television. None of it's real.
Just close your eyes for six hours.
It was... historical.
It was... loud.
It was... over. Mostly.
Distinguished. A distinguished event.
Big. A big one.
Smelly. Very smelly. (urk)
options.say: Smelly. Very smelly. (Your stomach turns over.)

options.text: Ceremonial. Like a... a ceremony.
Long. Ten minutes long.
Unnecessary.
Ancient. Proper, ancient technique.
Old. Like you.
Cardboardy.
AUTHENTIC. An authentic Grand Stenchmaster event.
Survivable. Probably.
Over? Is it over?
It's a licensed reenactment. They had permission to flutter.
It's only one sash. Hardly fluttering at all.
Don't look at it. Look at anything else. LOOK AT THE WALL.
Those are TRAINED sashes, Brogath. Years of training.
Well, it's two now. Double the flutter.
It's the same sash twice. Television's cheap.
Slow motion means it's CONTROLLED. Controlled commercial flutter.
It's going slowly so we can all see it properly.
You can see every thread, can't you.
Nobody's in it because it's a PROFESSIONAL. A sash performer. Working.
It's empty. Like a ghost sash.
Maybe it's yours. From before.
All together, in time: that's CEREMONIAL movement. A sash ceremony.
Historically authorised motion. There's precedent going back centuries.
That's a LOT of flutter.
At least they're not YOUR sashes.
They sound like they were family.
They sound like idiots.
options.reply: brogath: They were. They WERE. ...That's not the point.

options.text: You've got us now. You're part of this crew.
We could always draw them on some cardboard.
It's a... creative conversion. A very creative economic conversion.
You turned our money into WEEDS.
It's a mountain. Of stems. And my GOLD.
Licensed. LICENSED, Pete. Licensed professional advertising sashes. For controlled commercial flutter.
It's just a sash, mate. Enjoy it.
(say nothing, and eat a cracker)
options.say: (You eat a cracker. Everyone else is.)

options.text: She was a very good chicken, Brogath.
She'll be fine. Everything comes back out of that storm.
And she was the only thing that made you do the GREEN one.
That was very nearly it. Honestly. Very nearly.
Nobody could have done it better. Nobody alive, certainly.
You're a very good Grand Stenchmaster and it isn't your fault.
Is that ALL?
options.reply: pete[alarmed]: (from somewhere) Rule NINE, Captain! RULE NINE!

options.text: Whose fault was THAT, then?
That's... a very good swarm, Your Ancientness.
You were useful. Technically. In a way.
Tell me about them. Properly.
They sound like they were good friends.
You were a very good captain to them. I can tell.
They've been dead for centuries, Brogath.
Slow breaths. Hold the sash. Grand restraint.
You're doing brilliantly. Distinguished, even.
The procedure's the procedure. You like a procedure.
Is that ALL?
options.reply: tilda[furious]: RULE NINE, Captain. Even I know rule nine.
